name: Forest greens
summary: Forest-vegetable dishes cooked with the Ban Ang meal, separate from the forest-green salad.
origin: Ban Ang. The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism writes “các món từ rau rừng.” Bao Son La, 17 February 2023, names rau rừng among Thai and Muong dishes and again as something visitors carry home.
howToEat: Eat the greens with the village meal. A species list and a method are Check on arrival.
The price is Check on arrival.
where: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43. Bao Son La also names forest greens as a gift to carry, without a shop.
